verdict.rationale: Mirrors lets teams define success with their own outcome labels, checks, and customer feedback, and compares sessions against holdout groups on those outcomes. A UI fragment also shows sessions scored by checks ("3 of 4 checks passed"). Nothing shows these checks can be written as custom code, so support for code-based scorers is only implied. Missing for 10: documented way to author scorers or metrics in code, SDK or API for custom metrics, examples or reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
